title: The Best of Both Worlds at Seagrove Serenity
h1: The Best of Both Worlds at Seagrove Serenity
meta_description: Escape to this stunning 30A vacation rental in a gated community just minutes from the sugar-white sands of 30A. description_expanded: AboutProperty Highlights: ● Complimentary 6-Seater golf cart ● Close to public beach access ● Two community pools ● Gated community ● Four bicycles with locks ● Private nature boardwalk ● Screened in porches and balcony ● Fully stocked kitchen with crockpot, Keurig coffee machine, and 12-cup coffee pot ● Open concept living area ● Free wifi ● Four backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella ● Close to Seaside, Publix, restaurants, shopping, and entertainment ● Home is stocked with Starbucks coffee pack, creamer, sugar, bottles of water, and a starter amenity package with a roll of paper towels, dish soap, sponge, kitchen wipes, dishwasher soap, laundry detergent pods, pillow spray, shampoo, conditioner, aloe, lotion, bathroom soaps, and a roll of toilet paper in each bathroom. Step into The Best of Both Worlds at Seagrove Serenity, where the charm of coastal living meets the convenience of a prime location in the historic Seagrove neighborhood. Situated just a short walk to the sugar-white sands of Seagrove Beach and less than a mile to the iconic Seaside community, this home is the best of 30A. Cruise around the neighborhood in your included 6-seater golf cart, head to nearby Seagrove Village Market for lunch and Seaside for shopping and dinner, or enjoy peaceful evenings on the screened-in porch under the glow of café lights. With two community pools, a private nature boardwalk, and easy access to local attractions, this home truly lives up to its name. The main level invites you into an open-concept living space with 10-foot shiplap walls and hardwood floors that exude modern coastal elegance. The professionally designed kitchen is a chef’s dream, featuring Bosch appliances, quartz countertops, and plenty of space for preparing family meals. Flow seamlessly into the living and dining areas, where plush furnishings and natural light create the perfect relaxing atmosphere. Step outside to the screened porch, where you can enjoy serene views of the tranquil Seagrove neighborhood while sipping your morning coffee or winding down with evening cocktails. This 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom 30A vacation rental is designed for comfort and flexibility, accommodating up to 10 guests. The first-floor king ensuite is a private haven with easy access to the main living areas. The luxurious king primary suite on the second floor offers a private balcony, perfect for quiet moments and sunrise views. The third bedroom features two twin-over-twin beds with trundles and an ensuite bathroom, ideal for kids or groups traveling together. Each bedroom is thoughtfully designed with coastal décor and luxurious bedding to ensure a restful stay. With its prime location, upscale features, and thoughtful amenities, The Best of Both Worlds is more than just a luxury vacation rental—it’s a destination. Whether biking along scenic 30A, lounging by the community pool, or snorkeling the Sea Turtle Reef, this home offers the perfect balance of adventure and relaxation. Book your stay today and discover why this slice of paradise will become your new favorite retreat!
